summary: Bush-backed kerb with a dirt verge, but too steep at about 17%.
reasons: Backs onto bush, no homes within 20 m
Dirt verge gives room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush along the west side; nearest dwelling 24 m at the far end, homes across the road beyond 24 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a dirt verge beside the lane; room to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; light through traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted; a few cars park along it.

flags: Mapped gate 26 m away has a way round
Scouts hall mapped about 58 m away
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the west side; afternoon sun is blocked, morning sun comes from across the road.
cannot_judge: Whether the verge is firm enough

best_section.where: Woodstock Avenue west kerb, beside the bushland, north of the Montrose Road junction
